theHouse.title: The House of Arabian Sheikh
theHouse.subtitle: A Sanctuary of Rare Resins, Royal Distillations & Timeless Arab Craftsmanship
theHouse.storyDesc: Founded upon the sacred perfume traditions of the Arabian Peninsula, Arabian Sheikh was conceived not merely as a fragrance house, but as an eternal sanctuary of regal heritage. For generations, the royal courts of the Orient have celebrated fragrance as the highest form of hospitality, poetry, and devotion.
theHouse.oudDesc: Oud—known as 'Black Gold' and the Wood of the Gods—is the soul of our house. Sourced from century-old wild Aquilaria trees, distilled through traditional copper alembics, and aged in dark stone cellars, our Dehn Al Oud captures an earthy, balsamic, and divine resonance.
theHouse.bakhoorDesc: In the Arabian majlis, burning Bakhoor upon charcoal braziers is an act of noble welcome. Our incense chips are soaked for forty days in essential amber oils, frankincense tear drops, and pure floral absolutes, creating a fragrant mist that sanctifies rooms and garments.
theHouse.craftsmanshipDesc: Every Arabian Sheikh flacon is forged from ultra-dense crystal, adorned with a solid gold-finish zamak cap engraved with classical calligraphy, and hand-filled with Extrait de Parfum at supreme oil concentrations.
theHouse.ingredientsDesc: From rare mountain Taif Roses gathered at dawn before the sun warms the petals, to fossilized amber resin from ancient sands, only the most pristine grade-A botanicals are admitted into our private atelier.
theHouse.philosophyDesc: A true Arabian fragrance does not merely linger in the air—it commands respect, evokes nostalgia, and writes an indelible signature of nobility wherever you walk.

about.value2Desc: Every patron is received as an honored guest in the royal palace with bespoke concierge care.
about.value3Desc: Hand-poured flacons and hand-engraved seals designed to stand as treasured works of art on your vanity.
